description: Find research stations / field sites by country, abbreviation, type, location ID, or free-text. Countries filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code via countryCodes, or by free-form English country name via countryNames (resolved client-side to alpha-3 — "Uganda" → "UGA"). Optional bbox parameter restricts rows to a latitude/longitude window. When the spec-correct GeoJSON [lon, lat, alt] reading produces zero matches and at least one row carries a Point geometry, the bbox filter retries once with axes swapped (handles non-conformant servers that store [lat, lon, alt]) and surfaces a warning + `coordinateAxisOrder: "swapped"`. When the upstream total exceeds loadLimit, the full result set is materialized as a dataframe — query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

alias.description: Connection alias registered via brapi_connect. Omit to read the connection registered under alias `default` — i.e. a prior brapi_connect call that did not specify an alias. Calls that used a non-default alias must pass that same alias here.

bbox.description: Optional post-fetch bounding box. All four corners must be set to activate the filter.

maxLat.description: Maximum latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

maxLon.description: Maximum longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

minLat.description: Minimum latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

minLon.description: Minimum longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees.

countryNames.description: Free-form English country names or aliases (e.g. "Uganda", "United States", "USA") resolved client-side to ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes and merged into countryCodes. Names that do not resolve surface as a warning. Prefer countryCodes when you already have alpha-3 codes.

extraFilters.description: Extra BrAPI filters forwarded verbatim. Valid keys vary by endpoint; brapi_describe_filters enumerates them. Named params on this tool take precedence on conflict.

loadLimit.description: Cap on rows returned inline. Omit for the deployment default. Rows beyond the cap land in a dataframe; query with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL) instead of paging row-by-row.

name: brapi_find_locations

alias.description: Alias of the registered BrAPI connection the call used.

appliedFilters.description: The final filter map sent to the server (named + extraFilters).

coordinateAxisOrder.description: Axis interpretation used when reading GeoJSON Point coordinates. "spec" follows the GeoJSON RFC 7946 [lon, lat, alt?] convention. "swapped" indicates the upstream server stores [lat, lon, alt?] (non-conformant) and bbox + rendered coordinates were interpreted accordingly.

dataframe.description: Dataframe handle when the full result set was materialized as a dataframe. Query it with brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

columnLegend.description: Maps a sanitized column name back to its original upstream key, for columns renamed to clear the SQL-safe-identifier gate (e.g. `end` → `end_`). Present only when a column was renamed — write SQL against the sanitized (left-hand) names.

columns.description: Full column list of the dataframe.

items.description: Column name from the materialized rows.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the dataframe was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the dataframe metadata will be purged. Re-run the find_* tool to refresh, or copy results out before expiry.

maxRows.description: Cap that was applied at create time, when truncation occurred.

rowCount.description: Number of rows materialized in the dataframe.

tableName.description: Dataframe name. Use with brapi_dataframe_describe (schema + provenance) and brapi_dataframe_query (SQL).

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the upstream server (may exceed rowCount when truncated).

truncated.description: True when the dataframe hit a row cap before exhausting upstream.

distributions.description: Value frequency per field across the full result set.

countryCode.description: ISO country code → count of locations in that country.

locationType.description: Location type → count of locations of that type.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_alias`: No connection has been registered under the requested alias. `all_filters_dropped`: The active dialect dropped every filter the agent supplied — the upstream server does not honor any of the requested scope filters on this endpoint, so the call would silently widen to the unfiltered baseline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when more rows exist beyond the returned set.

notice.description: Guidance when no rows were returned — how to broaden filters or retry.

refinementHint.description: Suggested next-step query refinement when the result set is large.

results.description: Location rows returned in-context (up to loadLimit). Bbox filter is applied after the upstream fetch.

altitude.description: Altitude in meters above sea level.

coordinates.description: BrAPI v2 GeoJSON Feature carrying [lon, lat, alt?] in geometry.coordinates.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees (legacy field; modern servers use coordinates).

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees (legacy field; modern servers use coordinates).

returnedCount.description: Length of results[] after any bbox filtering.

totalCount.description: Total rows reported by the server (or the post-bbox count when a bbox filter is active).

warnings.description: Advisory messages (bbox malformed, filter overrides, capability gaps).

title: Brapi Find Locations
